5: main line Štefánikova čtvrť – Ústřední hřbitov, kurzy 1–12

line_card_notes.8: Split for Simutrans, where 8 and 8S are separate lines. 8S needs 7 trams: 28 min out, 4 min layover at Novolíšeňská, 29 min back and 2 min at Bohunice make a 63-min round trip, and at every 10 min that is 7 trams. 8 needs 16 (73-min round trip, two departures every 10 min), and the 24th tram is marked not needed. The records do not say which kurz ran the short trips, so 8S takes the five peak-only kurzy whose car changed between the morning and the afternoon (20, 26, 32, 42, 48) plus 44 and 46.

designed.why: 5S needs 5 trams (61-min round trip at every 10 min) and 4 were logged. 1088 (Pragoimex VarioLF2R.E) is the only car from the 5S history that was free on Fri 25 Sep: it ran 5S kurz 25 on Thu 24 Sep and kurz 27 on Thu 17 Sep, is active in the register, and appears on no line on 25 Sep. The four logged 5S trams already cover both 5S types (Škoda 03T6, VarioLF2R.E); no other free history car exists (line 5 records 16–24 Sep).

simutrans_lines.note: Peak reinforcement, about 14:30–16:30. Give it its own 7 trams (63-min round trip at every 10 min). It shares the whole route except Novolíšeňská – Mifkova with 8; 8S leaves Bohunice at :x0 and 8 at :x3 and :x7; Bohunice is a stub, so these are set unchanged.

simutrans_lines.note: Closure state to 30 Sep. After it, the western end moves one stop on to Vozovna Komín: the Vozovna Komín loop is 2 min further, so its offset is the Sochorova one + 2 − 1 for the loop = 13.

line_notes.10: Sochorova – Stránská skála every 20 min during the Kníničská closure (1–30 Sep 2026). Its usual western end since 18 Oct 2025 is the Vozovna Komín loop, one stop further.

texts.eyebrow: Brno · tramvaje · DPMB · pátek 25. 9. 2026 · odpolední špička
texts.lede: The trams on each kurz in the Friday afternoon peak (vypravenost of Fri 25 Sep 2026), set on the network as it stood on Sun 27 Sep 2026. Use it for the Simutrans model's line list, fleet allocation and depot plan. The fleet comes from Friday because that was the last weekday before 27 Sep; 28 Sep is a public holiday.
texts.network_intro: The weekday timetable in force on 27 Sep (IDS JMK GTFS, service day Fri 25 Sep).
texts.termini_intro: The termini from the Brno Termini sheet in their 27 Sep state: track count and layout, and the lines leaving each one between 16:00 and 16:59. The Kníničská closure keeps line 10 at Sochorova, so it does not reach Vozovna Komín.
texts.schedule_extra: Stub and turn-back termini (Mifkova, Nemocnice Bohunice, Sochorova) keep the real minute.
texts.schedule_exact: Each pattern is fitted to the afternoon peak core and reproduces the real departures exactly over the span shown, except line 12, whose real 5–6 minute headway has no whole-minute equivalent.
texts.method_state: Compared with the Termini sheet. Only the current state is kept. The projected “line 10 at Vozovna Komín” scenario, the hour switch, the track-plan simulation and the 60-minute rulers are gone. Line 10 runs Sochorova – Stránská skála until the Kníničská closure ends; from 29 Sep see the Brno Tram Fleet from 29 Sep sheet.
texts.method_extra:
Cross-check. The kurz counts per line (24, 15, 19, 16, 13, 17, 9, 24, 17, 5, 14) on Fri 25 Sep equal the afternoon totals from the 8–10 Sep records in the Termini sheet. They also fit the GTFS, which has 22, 11, 14, 14, 8, 14, 6, 20, 13, 3 and 10 trips on the move at 16:00; the remaining trams are standing at termini.

Closure timetable. Between 15:00 and 17:59 the 25 Sep timetable matches the 16 Sep data behind the Termini sheet, apart from one extra line 10 departure from Stránská skála at 17:47.
